104        public void init(InteractionDialogAPI dialog) {
105                this.dialog = dialog;
106                textPanel = dialog.getTextPanel();
107                options = dialog.getOptionPanel();
108                visual = dialog.getVisualPanel();
109
110                playerFleet = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
111                jumpPoint = (JumpPointAPI) (dialog.getInteractionTarget());
112                
113                fuelCost = playerFleet.getLogistics().getFuelCostPerLightYear();
114                float rounded = Math.round(fuelCost);
115                if (fuelCost > 0 && rounded <= 0) rounded = 1;
116                fuelCost = rounded;
117                
118                if (isWormhole()) {
119                        fuelCost *= WORMHOLE_FUEL_USE_MULT;
120                } else if (jumpPoint.isInHyperspace()) {
121                        fuelCost = 0f;
122                }
123                
124                canAfford = fuelCost <= playerFleet.getCargo().getFuel();
125                
126                visual.setVisualFade(0.25f, 0.25f);
127                if (jumpPoint.getCustomInteractionDialogImageVisual() != null) {
128                        visual.showImageVisual(jumpPoint.getCustomInteractionDialogImageVisual());
129                } else {
130                        if (isWormhole()) {
131                                visual.showImagePortion("illustrations", "jump_point_wormhole", 640, 400, 0, 0, 480, 300);
132                        } else {
133                                if (playerFleet.getContainingLocation().isHyperspace()) {
134                                        visual.showImagePortion("illustrations", "jump_point_hyper", 640, 400, 0, 0, 480, 300);
135                                } else {
136                                        visual.showImagePortion("illustrations", "jump_point_normal", 640, 400, 0, 0, 480, 300);
137                                }
138                        }
139                }
140                
141//              dialog.hideVisualPanel();
142//              dialog.setTextWidth(1000);
143        
144                dialog.setOptionOnEscape("Leave", OptionId.LEAVE);
145                
146                optionSelected(null, OptionId.INIT);
147        }

491        protected void showWarningIfNeeded() {
492                if (isWormhole()) return;
493                
494                if (jumpPoint.getDestinations().isEmpty()) return;
495                JumpDestination dest = jumpPoint.getDestinations().get(0);
496                SectorEntityToken target = dest.getDestination();
497                if (target == null || target.getContainingLocation() == null) return;
498                
499                List<CampaignFleetAPI> fleets = new ArrayList<CampaignFleetAPI>();
500                boolean hostile = false;
501                float minDist = Float.MAX_VALUE;
502                int maxDanger = 0;
503                for (CampaignFleetAPI other : target.getContainingLocation().getFleets()) {
504                        float dist = Misc.getDistance(target, other);
505                        if (dist < 1000) {
506                                fleets.add(other);
507                                if (other.getAI() != null) {
508                                        hostile |= other.getAI().isHostileTo(Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet());
509                                } else {
510                                        hostile |= other.getFaction().isHostileTo(Factions.PLAYER);
511                                }
512                                if (other.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_PIRATE)) {
513                                        hostile = true;
514                                }
515                                if (hostile) {
516                                        maxDanger = Math.max(maxDanger, Misc.getDangerLevel(other));
517                                }
518                                if (dist < minDist) minDist = dist;
519                        }
520                }
521                TextPanelAPI text = dialog.getTextPanel();
522                
523                if (maxDanger >= 2) {
524                        String noun = "jump-point";
525                        if (isWormhole()) noun = "wormhole";
526                        text.addPara("Warning!", Misc.getNegativeHighlightColor());
527                        Global.getSoundPlayer().playUISound("cr_playership_malfunction", 1f, 0.25f);
528                        
529                        String where = "a short distance away from the exit";
530                        String whereHL = "";
531                        if (minDist < 300) {
532                                where = "extremely close to the exit";
533                                whereHL = where;
534                        }
535                        text.addPara("The jump-point exhibits fluctuations " +
536                                                                                  "characteristic of drive field activity " + where + ".",
537                                                                                  Misc.getNegativeHighlightColor(), whereHL);
538                        
539                        text.addPara("A disposable probe sends back a microburst of information: forces " +
540                                        "near the exit are assessed likely hostile and a possible threat to your fleet.",
541                                         Misc.getNegativeHighlightColor(), "hostile", "threat");
542                }
543        }

545        private Map<OptionId, JumpDestination> destinationMap = new HashMap<OptionId, JumpDestination>();
546        private void createInitialOptions() {
547                options.clearOptions();
548
549                boolean dev = Global.getSettings().isDevMode();
550                float navigation = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet().getCommanderStats().getSkillLevel("navigation");
551                boolean isStarAnchor = jumpPoint.isStarAnchor();
552                boolean okToUseIfAnchor = isStarAnchor && navigation >= 7;
553                
554                okToUseIfAnchor = true;
555                if (isStarAnchor && !okToUseIfAnchor && dev) {
556                        addText("(Can always be used in dev mode)");
557                }
558                okToUseIfAnchor |= dev;
559                
560                String noun = "jump-point";
561                if (isWormhole()) noun = "wormhole";
562                
563                boolean unstable = jumpPoint.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean(UNSTABLE_KEY);
564                boolean canStabilize = jumpPoint.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean(CAN_STABILIZE);
565                
566                if (unstable) {
567                        if (canStabilize) {
568                                options.addOption("Stabilize the jump-point", OptionId.STABILIZE, null);
569                        }
570                } else {
571                        if (jumpPoint.getDestinations().isEmpty()) {
572                                if (isWormhole()) {
573                                        addText("This wormhole is not connected to any other termini and is effectively unusable.");
574                                } else {
575                                        addText(getString("noExits"));
576                                }
577                        } else if (playerFleet.getCargo().getFuel() <= 0 && !canAfford) {
578                                //addText(getString("noFuel"));
579                        } else if (isStarAnchor && !okToUseIfAnchor) {
580                                addText(getString("starAnchorUnusable"));
581                        } else if (canAfford) {
582                                int index = 0;
583                                for (JumpDestination dest : jumpPoint.getDestinations()) {
584                                        if (index >= jumpOptions.size()) break;
585                                        OptionId option = jumpOptions.get(index);
586                                        index++;
587                                        
588                                        if (isWormhole()) {
589                                                options.addOption("Initiate a transit to " + dest.getLabelInInteractionDialog(), option, null);
590                                                
591                                                boolean canUse = WormholeScannerPlugin.canPlayerUseWormholes();
592                                                if (!canUse) {
593                                                        options.setEnabled(option, false);
594                                                        options.setTooltip(option, "Using a wormhole requires a wormhole scanner.");
595                                                }
596                                                
597                                        } else { 
598                                                options.addOption("Order a jump to " + dest.getLabelInInteractionDialog(), option, null);
599                                        }
600                                        destinationMap.put(option, dest);
601                                }
602                        }
603                }
604                
605                if (isWormhole()) {
606                        options.addOption("Shut down the wormhole and retrieve the anchor", OptionId.RETRIEVE_ANCHOR, null);
607                }
608                
609                options.addOption("Leave", OptionId.LEAVE, null);
610                options.setShortcut(OptionId.LEAVE, Keyboard.KEY_ESCAPE, false, false, false, true);
611
612                if (Global.getSettings().getBoolean("oneClickJumpPoints")) {
613                        if (jumpPoint.getDestinations().size() == 1) {
614                                dialog.setOpacity(0);
615                                dialog.setBackgroundDimAmount(0f);
616                                optionSelected(null, OptionId.JUMP_1);
617                        }
618                }
619                
620                if (Global.getSettings().isDevMode()) {
621                        DevMenuOptions.addOptions(dialog);
622                }
623        }

645        private String getString(String id) {

648                String fleetOrShip = "fleet";

653                        }
654                }
655                str = str.replaceAll("\\$fleetOrShip", fleetOrShip);
656                
657                return str;

670        public static boolean hasJumpPay(LocationAPI from, LocationAPI to) {
671                if (!(Misc.isExtended() || !Global.getSettings().getBoolean("jumpPayEnabledExtModeOnly"))) {
672                        return false;
673                }
674                float jumpMult = Global.getSettings().getFloat("ext_jumpPayMult");
675                if (jumpMult <= 0f) return false;
676                
677                if (from == null) return false;
678                if (to == null) return false;
679                
680                if (from.isHyperspace()) return false;
681                if (!to.isHyperspace()) return false;
682                
683                //if (!from.hasTag(Tags.THEME_CORE_POPULATED)) return false;
684                //if (Misc.getMarketsInLocation(from).isEmpty()) return false;
685                if (isPopulatedForJumpPay(from)) return true;
686                
687                return false;
688        }
689        
690        public static boolean isPopulatedForJumpPay(LocationAPI location) {
691                for (MarketAPI market : Misc.getMarketsInLocation(location)) {
692                        if (market.isHidden()) continue;
693                        return true;
694                }
695                return false;
696        }
697        
698        public static int computeJumpPay() {
699                float jumpMult = Global.getSettings().getFloat("ext_jumpPayMult");
700                
701                CampaignFleetAPI fleet = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
702                if (fleet == null) {
703                        return 0;
704                }
705                
706                int payout = (int) Math.round(Misc.computeTotalCrewSalaryForPlayerFleet() * jumpMult);
707                return payout;
708        }
709        
710        public static void computeAndApplyJumpPay(LocationAPI from, LocationAPI to) {
711                if (!hasJumpPay(from, to)) return;
712                
713                CampaignFleetAPI fleet = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
714                if (fleet == null) {
715                        return;
716                }
717                
718                int payout = computeJumpPay();
719                
720                int credits = (int) fleet.getCargo().getCredits().get();
721                int owed = Math.max(0, payout - credits);
722                if (owed > 0) payout -= owed;
723                
724                if (payout > 0) {
725                        fleet.getCargo().getCredits().subtract(payout);
726                        if (fleet.getCargo().getCredits().get() < 0) {
727                                fleet.getCargo().getCredits().set(0);
728                        }
729                }
730                
731                if (owed > 0) {
732                        MonthlyReport report = SharedData.getData().getCurrentReport();
733                        
734                        FDNode backpayNode = report.getNode(MonthlyReport.FLEET, MonthlyReport.CREW, MonthlyReport.JUMP_PAY);
735                        backpayNode.name = "Owed jump pay";
736                        backpayNode.custom = MonthlyReport.JUMP_PAY;
737                        backpayNode.tooltipCreator = report.getMonthlyReportTooltip();
738                        backpayNode.upkeep += owed;
739                }
740                
741                if (payout > 0) {
742                        String payStr = "" + Misc.getDGSCredits(Math.abs(payout));
743                        MessageIntel intel = new MessageIntel("Jump pay: " + payStr,
744                                        Misc.getBasePlayerColor(), new String[] {payStr},
745                                        Misc.getNegativeHighlightColor());
746                        Global.getSector().getCampaignUI().addMessage(intel);
747                }
748                if (owed > 0) {
749                        String owedStr = "" + Misc.getDGSCredits(Math.abs(owed));
750                        MessageIntel intel = new MessageIntel("Owed jump pay: " + owedStr,
751                                        Misc.getBasePlayerColor(), new String[] {owedStr},
752                                        Misc.getNegativeHighlightColor());
753                        Global.getSector().getCampaignUI().addMessage(intel);
754                }
755        }
